name: clippers
title: Clippers
description: For walk-in barber shops: every service hangs from a chrome rail on a black clipper-guard tab with comb teeth, its price in heavy white figures, on a cape-white page under one red, white and blue pole stripe.

tokens.--font-figure: the heavy figures: prices and dates on the guards, phone numbers, the right-aligned price column of a table, and the shop name
tokens.--font-body: body text, headings and the menu
tokens.--text-s: small text: labels, the footer, table headings, pagination
tokens.--text-note: the line about each job in the rack on the home page
tokens.--text-l: service titles beside the guards, the standfirst, customer quotes, sub-headings and the shop name
tokens.--text-xl: section headings and the phone number in the call block
tokens.--leading-tight: line spacing of headings and the shop name
tokens.--tracking-caps: letter spacing of small capital labels
tokens.--color-text: body text, headings, the shop name, the menu, the ticks of the checklist, the heavy line under table headings and under the current menu item
tokens.--color-muted: secondary text: the standfirst, descriptions, labels, the footer
tokens.--color-accent: links, phone numbers, the keyboard focus ring, and a guard while its row is hovered
tokens.--color-chrome: the darker edge of the chrome rails, the dividing lines of tables and lists and of the door sign, the outline of code blocks, the footer line, the caps of the pole stripe, the shade at the edge of a wide table that scrolls on a phone
tokens.--color-shine: the lighter edge of the chrome rails
tokens.--color-guard: the guard tab and its teeth, the door sign on the home page, and the ground of selected text and the skip link
tokens.--color-figure: the price and the small label printed on a guard, the words on the door sign, and selected text
tokens.--color-pole-red: red bands of the pole stripe under the masthead
tokens.--color-pole-white: white bands of the pole stripe
tokens.--color-pole-blue: blue bands of the pole stripe
tokens.--measure: widest a column of text may get
tokens.--gutter: space between the page and the edge of the screen
tokens.--rack-col: narrowest a hanger (guard and title) may get before the rack drops a column
tokens.--gap-s: small gap: between a heading and its text, inside table rows
tokens.--gap-m: standard gap: between paragraphs, between a guard and its title
tokens.--gap-xl: gap above the call block and under the rack, and between the text and the call block beside it
tokens.--radius: corner rounding of pictures, code blocks and the focus ring
tokens.--rail: thickness of the chrome rails (over each guard, over the call block, beside a quote, the rule in page text) and of the line under the current menu item
tokens.--focus: thickness of the keyboard focus ring
tokens.--guard-size: size of the figure on a guard; the whole guard scales with it
tokens.--guard-width: narrowest a guard may get, in ems of its figure (a long price widens it, then takes a second line)
tokens.--guard-height: shortest a guard may get, in ems of its figure
tokens.--tooth-pitch: distance from one comb tooth to the next
tokens.--tooth-length: length of the comb teeth under a guard
tokens.--pole-band: width of each diagonal band in the pole stripe
